name: prelaunch-audit-report
description: Turns repo scanners, a Row Level Security probe in PGlite and live-URL checks into a severity-rated pre-launch audit report (JSON, HTML, PDF) with verified patch diffs, for Next.js or Vite/React + Supabase + Stripe apps. Personal project.
author: Sunnatulla E.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.sample: node src/cli.ts test/fixtures/broken-notes-app --out examples/sample-report --date 2026-11-09T09:00:00Z --note "Sample report. broken-notes-app is a small Next.js + Supabase + Stripe demo written with security holes on purpose for this repo's tests (test/fixtures/broken-notes-app). Every finding below is real tool output on that code. It is not a client project."
scripts.sample:vite: node src/cli.ts test/fixtures/pipeline-crm-app --out examples/sample-report-vite-supabase --date 2026-11-15T09:00:00Z --note "Sample report. pipeline-crm is a small Vite + React + Supabase Edge Functions demo, shaped like the apps AI builders generate, written with security holes on purpose for this repo's tests (test/fixtures/pipeline-crm-app). Every finding below is real tool output on that code. It is not a client project."
